description: This file defines IPC message handling classes and templates within the WPEFramework Core namespace, including scalar types, text, and buffer types used for inter-process communication.

classes.name: ScalarType
classes.description: Template class for scalar data types, specialized for string type to handle string serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: Template class for fixed-length text strings with serialization/deserialization support.

classes.name: BufferType
classes.description: Template class for managing byte buffers with serialization/deserialization capabilities.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for ScalarType and Text classes.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Getter and setter for scalar data in ScalarType.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the length of the text or data.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the object into a byte buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a byte buffer into the object.
